notes: Empty subcommand reaches the C warning instead of the generic unknown-command response.
The delete arm with no address emits the exact Delete what? line.
The three-octet sscanf gate rejects malformed input with the same line.
The add arm requires both IP and host name and emits Add what? when absent.
A valid address without a second token remains an add-argument failure.
Four parsed octets are prepended into the authoritative hash bucket and acknowledge with OK!.
The optional fourth octet remains -1, matching C's add initialization and persisted cache state.
The abbreviated del path marks every entry sharing the first three octets and emits each deletion in bucket-list order.
An unrecognized non-empty subcommand falls through do_dns without player-facing output.

C's list buffer uses overlapping sprintf input/output, and the empty etc/dns fixture also reaches boot_dns's uninitialized EOF-buffer path; the shipped Linux oracle emits unstable garbage, so this reachable branch is excluded under R1/R5e (precedent: auto.no-arg-listing-undefined).
